text.name: Sewaddle
text.flavor: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

text.name: Swadloon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Healing Leaves
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

text.name: Leavanny

attacks.name: Healing Wrapping
attacks.text: Heal 100 damage from each of your Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

text.flavor: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

text.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

attacks.name: Energy Gift
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wondrous Cotton
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Deerling
text.flavor: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

text.name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

text.name: Shelmet

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Karrablast in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

text.flavor: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

text.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

text.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Emerald Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

text.flavor: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

text.name: Tepig
text.flavor: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

text.name: Pignite
text.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

text.name: Emboar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Inferno Fandango
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {Fire} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

text.name: Pansear

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

text.flavor: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600°F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

text.name: Simisear
text.flavor: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

text.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Brighten and Burn
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

text.flavor: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

text.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

text.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Incendiary Pillar
attacks.text: If you have 10 or more Basic {Fire} Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Burn It All Up
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

text.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Licking Catch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of {Fire} Pokémon and Basic {Fire} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

attacks.name: Blazing Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Oshawott
text.flavor: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

text.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Energized Shell
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

text.name: Samurott

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Torrential Whirlpool
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Energized Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

text.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Bared Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

text.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Firefighting
attacks.text: Discard a {Fire} Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

text.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

text.name: Vanillite

attacks.name: Ice Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The temperature of their breath is -58°F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

text.name: Vanillish

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

text.name: Vanilluxe

attacks.name: Double Freeze
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Blitzle
text.flavor: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

text.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

text.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

text.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all {Lightning} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.flavor: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

text.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Muddy Bolt
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any {Fighting} Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

text.name: Woobat
text.flavor: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

text.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Happy Return
attacks.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

text.flavor: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

text.name: Sigilyph

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

text.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

text.name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Extended Damagriiigus
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

text.name: Gothita
text.flavor: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

text.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

text.flavor: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

text.name: Gothitelle

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Distorted Future
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Synchro Shot
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

text.flavor: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

text.name: Frillish

attacks.name: Oceanic Gloom
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

text.flavor: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Oceanic Curse
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards or Pokémon Tool cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 80 more damage.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less.

text.flavor: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

text.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has {Fighting} Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

text.flavor: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

text.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Vengeful Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched {Fighting} Pokémon.

text.flavor: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

text.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Rising Chop
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

text.name: Archen

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

text.name: Archeops

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Ancient Wing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

text.name: Mienfoo
text.flavor: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

text.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Smash Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

text.name: Terrakion

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

text.flavor: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

text.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Invite Evil
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 {Darkness} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

text.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

text.name: Scraggy
text.flavor: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

text.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Ruffians Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each {Darkness} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

text.name: Trubbish
text.flavor: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

text.name: Garbodor

attacks.name: Gunk Shot
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

text.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

text.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

text.flavor: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

text.name: Vullaby
text.flavor: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

text.name: Mandibuzz

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Look for Prey
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less that you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

text.flavor: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

text.name: Deino

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

text.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Greedy Eater
abilities.text: If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Dark Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Ferroseed
text.flavor: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

text.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Power Whip
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

text.name: Durant

attacks.name: Bite Together
attacks.text: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

text.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

text.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Procurement
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

text.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

text.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

text.name: Herdier

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

text.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Odor Sleuth
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Special Fang
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.

text.flavor: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Bouffer
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gold Breaker
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Tornadus

attacks.name: Wrapped in Wind
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.text: Move a Basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

text.name: Antique Plume Fossil

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Plume Protection
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

effect: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {Colorless} Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Brave Bangle
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Energy Retrieval
effect: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Harlequin
effect: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Hilda
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Tool Scrapper
effect: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Ignition Energy
effect: If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.
If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides {Colorless}{Colorless}{Colorless} Energy instead.

text.name: Sewaddle
text.flavor: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

text.flavor: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

text.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Bared Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

text.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Firefighting
attacks.text: Discard a {Fire} Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

text.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

text.name: Vanillite

attacks.name: Ice Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The temperature of their breath is -58°F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

text.name: Vanillish

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

text.name: Vanilluxe

attacks.name: Double Freeze
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

text.name: Blitzle
text.flavor: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

text.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

text.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

text.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all {Lightning} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.flavor: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

text.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Muddy Bolt
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any {Fighting} Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

text.name: Woobat
text.flavor: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

text.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Happy Return
attacks.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

text.flavor: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

text.name: Sigilyph

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

text.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

text.name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Extended Damagriiigus
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

text.name: Gothita
text.flavor: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

text.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

text.flavor: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

text.name: Frillish

attacks.name: Oceanic Gloom
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

text.flavor: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

text.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less.

text.flavor: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

text.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has {Fighting} Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

text.flavor: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

text.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Vengeful Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched {Fighting} Pokémon.

text.flavor: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

text.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Rising Chop
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

text.name: Archen

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

text.name: Archeops

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Ancient Wing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

text.name: Mienfoo
text.flavor: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

text.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Smash Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

text.name: Terrakion

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

text.flavor: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

text.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Invite Evil
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 {Darkness} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

text.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

text.name: Scraggy
text.flavor: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

text.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Ruffians Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each {Darkness} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

text.name: Trubbish
text.flavor: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

text.name: Garbodor

attacks.name: Gunk Shot
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

text.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

text.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

text.flavor: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

text.name: Vullaby
text.flavor: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

text.name: Mandibuzz

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Look for Prey
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less that you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

text.flavor: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

text.name: Deino

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

text.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

text.name: Ferroseed
text.flavor: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

text.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Power Whip
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

text.name: Durant

attacks.name: Bite Together
attacks.text: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

text.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

text.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Procurement
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

text.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

text.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

text.name: Herdier

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

text.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Odor Sleuth
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Special Fang
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.

text.flavor: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

attacks.name: Energy Gift
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wondrous Cotton
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Blazing Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Oceanic Curse
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards or Pokémon Tool cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 80 more damage.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Greedy Eater
abilities.text: If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Dark Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Bouffer
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gold Breaker
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Harlequin
effect: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Hilda
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

text.name: Hilda
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Force
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

attacks.name: Blazing Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
